newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission to clarify rules for environment taxes.
newsitem.headline: Commission to clarify rules for environment taxes.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to adopt a communication on Wednesday clarifying how national environment taxes can be allowed in the EU's internal market, Commission officials said on Monday.
The paper was separated from another proposal to revise a directive on excise duties on mineral oils, which could be adopted as early as next month, the sources said.

"The problem sometimes arises of finding out whether a proposed tax is in accordance with single market rules," a Commission spokesman said, adding: "The communication examines the situation and propose guidelines."
He refused to elaborate, but another Commission official noted that the adoption in the Nordic countries of such taxes to protect the environment had prompted the need to clarify the legal situation.
The communication was prepared under the responsibility of Internal Market Commissioner Mario Monti and his environment counterpart Ritt Bjerregaard.
